title: Does Item Response Theory Generalize Across Languages? Evidence from Cross-Lingual LLM Benchmarks
abstract: arXiv:2611.31261v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The application of Item Response Theory (IRT) for data selection in benchmarks has mostly been limited to monolingual settings. In this work, we ask: how does IRT generalize when the same benchmark is translated across languages? We conduct experiments on Multilingual GSM and Global MMLU, covering over 100 language models and 11 languages. Fitting 1PL, 2PL, and 3PL IRT models per language, we assess cross-lingual consistency of parameters and whether IRT-filtered subsets preserve model rankings across languages: item difficulty emerges as the most stable parameter followed by guessing and then discrimination. translated_title: 项目反应理论能否跨语言泛化？来自跨语言LLM基准测试的证据
translated_abstract: 项目反应理论（IRT）在基准测试数据选择中的应用大多局限于单语环境。在本工作中，我们提出这样一个问题：当同一个基准被翻译成不同语言时，IRT如何泛化？我们在Multilingual GSM和Global MMLU上进行了实验，涵盖超过100个语言模型和11种语言。通过为每种语言分别拟合1PL、2PL和3PL IRT模型，我们评估了参数的跨语言一致性，以及经IRT筛选的子集能否在各语言间保持模型排名：结果显示题目难度是最稳定的参数，其次是猜测参数，再其次是区分度参数。差异题目分析还表明，不稳定性的根源可以追溯到特定题目在跨语言翻译过程中发生的偏移。我们的研究结果表明，在多语言环境中基于IRT的数据选择必须同时具备参数感知和题目感知能力，即在假设跨语言一致性成立之前，需要先验证模型选择的适用性并逐一筛查具体题目。
tldr: 该研究通过在Multilingual GSM和Global MMLU上对100多个语言模型拟合1PL/2PL/3PL IRT模型，发现题目难度是跨语言最稳定的IRT参数，而猜测和区分度的稳定性依次减弱，因此多语言场景下基于IRT的数据选择需要先验证模型选择并逐一筛查具体题目。
en_tdlr: By fitting 1PL/2PL/3PL IRT models on Multilingual GSM and Global MMLU with over 100 language models across 11 languages, this study finds item difficulty is the most cross-lingually stable IRT parameter, followed by guessing and then discrimination, implying IRT-based multilingual data selection must validate model choice and screen individual items before assuming cross-lingual generalization.
